_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Physical Inventories Report
summary: The Physical Inventories Report documents inventories of Government-furnished and contractor-acquired material and nonexpendable special tooling, special test equipment, and accessories, on a quantitative and monetary basis by property category.
description_purpose: The Physical Inventories Report documents inventories of Government-furnished/contractor-acquired material and nonexpendable special tooling (including vendor tools); special test equipment; and all accessories and attachments; on both a quantitative and monetary basis segregated by categories of property.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This data item is applicable to contracts in which Government-furnished and contractor-acquired material are requisitioned.

7.2 This data item description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.3 Reporting is usually required on an annual basis.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Specific Instructions.
preparation_instructions.content: The Physical Inventories Report shall consist of the following three sections:

children.title: Section I - Tally Sheet Inventory Voucher.
children.content: The Tally Sheet Inventory voucher (Figure 1) shall contain a physical inventory count to include vendor tooling and other subcontractor items with results of each inventory listed, and shall consist of the following:

children.title: Contractor
children.content: Name of contractor submitting the report

children.title: Contract Number
children.content: Contract items are accountable under

children.title: Indicate by "X" - Type
children.content: the type of inventory being conducted

children.title: Page-of page
children.content: Self explanatory

children.title: Date Prepared
children.content: Data the vouchers are prepared

children.title: Item No.
children.content: Items numbered starting with (1)

children.title: Stock/Part Number
children.content: National Stock Number or Part Number

children.title: Description
children.content: Noun name of item

children.title: Unit of issue
children.content: Each, feet, meters, etc.

children.title: Unit Cost
children.content: Individual item prices

children.title: Recorded Balance
children.content: Stock Record Count

children.title: Inventory Balance
children.content: Physical quantity on hand

children.title: Over
children.content: Quantity inventory count is greater than recorded balance and cost

children.title: Short
children.content: Quantity inventory count is less than recorded balance and cost

children.title: Total
children.content: combined count of each line item

children.title: Posted by and Dated
children.content: Initialed and dated by the individual performing the inventory

children.title: Certifying Signature and Date
children.content: Initialed and dated by the Property Administrator

children.title: Section II - Inventory Adjustment Voucher.
children.content: The Inventory Adjustment Voucher (Figure 2) shall identify the adjustment of shortages and overages for material only, and shall consist of existing variations between physical inventory count and previous "Balance on Hand" quantity. The Inventory Adjustment Voucher shall be recorded as follows:

children.title: Item No.
children.content: Items numbered starting with one (1)

children.title: Part Number/NSN
children.content: Recorded Part Number or National Stock Number

children.title: Description
children.content: Noun name of item

children.title: Quantity Over
children.content: Quantity greater than the recorded stock balance

children.title: Quantity Short
children.content: Quantity less than the recorded stock balance

children.title: Unit Price
children.content: Cost per piece of line item

children.title: Total Price
children.content: Combined cost of line item

children.title: Section III - Physical Inventory Certification Sheet.
children.content: Contains a statement specifying a given date in which physical inventory of all Government-owned property was completed and that the official records are in agreement with the actual quantities of property on hand.
